snippet.title: Human Fall Flat - Out Now on Nintendo Switch 2!
snippet.description:
Human Fall Flat has fallen onto the Nintendo Switch 2!

This enhanced edition brings the full dose of charm, chaos, and creativity fans adore — now optimized for Nintendo’s next-generation console. Players can dive into a delightful mix of brand-new levels, including Dockyard, Museum, Hike, and the sugary sweet Candyland, alongside timeless fan-favourites like Castle, Aztec, and Water. Even better: all future levels will be included.

Whether you’re upgrading from the original Nintendo Switch version or jumping in for the first time, the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition brings the ultimate Human Fall Flat experience.

Players can enjoy:

- All current and future levels — from classics to brand-new worlds including 5 NEW levels available for Nintendo Switch 2!
- Online multiplayer for up to 8 players — where teamwork, chaos, and laughter collide. 
- Endless possibilities — push, pull, climb, flop, and fumble your way through ingenious puzzles, solo or with friends.

https://www.nintendo.com/en-gb/Games/Nintendo-Switch-2-Edition/Human-Fall-Flat-Nintendo-Switch-2-Edition-3054059.html
